summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace objects. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ does prefix membership (str(ref).startswith(str(self))), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when str(ref) equals a stored term URI, so _RDFNamespace inherits it. Term resolution and errors are unchanged, and NamespaceManager was not touched. In test/test_namespace.py, I added NamespaceContainsTest covering Namespace prefix positive/negative cases, SH membership, RDFS label (True) and example (False), RDF type (True), and RDF _1 (False). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. Nothing was committed.
